Instead, it repeatedly tries plausible splits of the input under top‐down intuition, appeals to “this nonterminal only has these terminals so it can’t match,” and finally rejects by a high‐level observation about leftmost tokens. It doesn’t write code or give a rigorous derivation. This is a heuristic approach.  

Classification: heuristic

There’s no guesswork or high-level heuristic appeal, nor does it write code—it builds a concrete derivation. This is a rule-based approach.

Instead, it systematically tries to apply the grammar’s production rules to prove or disprove membership. This is a rule-based strategy.
